title: Smoother combat at a shared table
summary: Players at one table on the same Wi-Fi are no longer locked out of signing in while the DM runs combat, and combat views use less data.
items: Signed-in account requests now count against each account instead of the household's connection, so a DM's open encounter views no longer use up everyone's allowance. Sign-in and recovery attempts keep their existing per-connection limit.
The TV display controls and the map Initiative panel share one encounter update instead of each checking on its own.
The combat status bar and the Initiative panel pause while their tab is hidden and catch up when you return; players' Initiative panels only check while the DM shows combat on that map.
Each combat update now reads the campaign once and no longer downloads map pictures.
